title: Hom from bounded-above finite-free complexes preserves bounded-below acyclicity
statement: Let $(U,\mathcal O_U)$ be a ringed site [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $E^\bullet$ be a bounded-above cochain complex [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] whose terms are finite-rank free $\mathcal O_U$-modules, and let $A^\bullet$ be a bounded-below acyclic cochain complex of $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then the total sheaf Hom complex $\mathcal H om^\bullet_{\mathcal O_U}(E^\bullet,A^\bullet)$ [def-pur-hom-complex] is acyclic.
